name: Crystal Rain
source:
──There is a seven-year rift between me and my parents.

Kanade Kamiya (the protagonist) was kidnapped as a young child and returned to her family after seven years.
However, the bond between parent and child, exposed to the ravages of time, had frayed to the point of snapping.
Amidst an atmosphere of distant awkwardness, the three of them clumsily try to maintain the roles of "parent" and "child."

Once upon a time, the world was soft and sweet, like meringue.
But not a trace of that remains.
Black rain pours down upon the town, and the world has been utterly transformed.
For her parents, the change began that day twelve years ago when their daughter vanished.
For Kanade, it began that day five years ago when she returned to this world.

Kanade spends her days ruled by inertia and emptiness—until one day, she encounters someone who sets the hands of a stopped clock in motion.

The Clock Tower’s caretaker, who hunts the defiled.
A madman who strikes down illusions with a rusted sword.
A harbinger of ruin bearing the blood of a witch.

...He knows there is nothing his tainted hands can heal.
Yet he cannot give up, for a promise was made.
The reality of living while betraying her is agonizing; he would willingly sacrifice everything if only he could fulfill that vow.
...And yet, he knows that whatever he does is meaningless.
The rotted meringue melts away like mud, and maggots, drawn by the stench, swarm over the remains.

Do you remember the kindness of the world?

[Translated from [url=https://bottle-nasu.itch.io/crystal-rain]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
——我与父母之间，横亘着一道长达七年的裂痕。

加宫奏（主人公）在幼年时遭遇绑架，时隔七年才回到家人身边。
然而，经受漫长岁月侵蚀的亲子羁绊，早已磨损得几近断裂。
在疏离而尴尬的气氛中，三人笨拙地维系着“父母”与“孩子”的角色。

曾几何时，这个世界如蛋白霜般松软而甜美。
可如今，那一切已荡然无存。
黑色的雨倾盆洒落在小镇上，世界早已面目全非。
对她的父母而言，一切的改变始于十二年前女儿失踪的那一天。
对奏而言，则始于五年前她重返这个世界的那一天。

奏在惰性与空虚的支配下度日——直到某一天，她邂逅了那个拨动停滞时钟指针的人。

狩猎污秽之物的钟塔看守。
挥舞锈剑斩碎幻影的狂人。
流淌着魔女之血的破灭先驱。

……他深知，自己那双沾满污秽的手治愈不了任何事物。
即便如此他也无法放弃，因为曾许下过约定。
在背叛她的同时苟活于世的现实令他痛彻心扉；只要能践行那份誓言，他甘愿献出一切。
……然而他也明白，无论自己做什么都毫无意义。
腐烂的蛋白霜如泥泞般融化殆尽，恶臭引来蛆虫，在残骸之上肆意攒动。

你还记得这个世界的温柔吗？

[译自[url=https://bottle-nasu.itch.io/crystal-rain]itch.io[/url]]
